data.description: Limlet is a concept play area from our Funplay Originals Conceptual collection, laid out as a cluster of pieces rather than one tower. Yellow arch climbers curve over the space, a red slide runs off the main arch, and a nest swing and spinner seats sit alongside. Because the pieces stand apart, children can climb, slide, swing and spin in different corners at the same time while parents sit close by. The finish is Banana Yellow with Cherry Red. We have not published an age group, capacity or safe play area for Limlet yet, so we size each layout to the site. Share your plot dimensions and photos and we will send a layout drawing with the safe zone marked.

items.pText: Limlet is a concept play area from our Funplay Originals Conceptual collection, laid out as a cluster of pieces rather than one tower. Yellow arch climbers curve over the space, a red slide runs off the main arch, and a nest swing and spinner seats sit alongside. Because the pieces stand apart, children can climb, slide, swing and spin in different corners at the same time while parents sit close by. The finish is Banana Yellow with Cherry Red. We have not published an age group, capacity or safe play area for Limlet yet, so we size each layout to the site. Share your plot dimensions and photos and we will send a layout drawing with the safe zone marked.

Limlet is planned per site, so the final specification depends on which arch climbers, swings and spinners you keep in the cluster. Each element gets its own safe zone on our layout drawing, and the swings need clear space in front and behind. We fix the pieces self-standing or grouted to suit your ground. Ask our team for the material and warranty details of your chosen configuration.
